description: Magic Hour is an AI media platform for generating and editing video, images, and audio in a browser workspace and through developer APIs. It also publishes agent-oriented resources such as MCP servers, OpenAPI, llms.txt, and agent skills for integrating those capabilities into apps and AI assistants.
summary: Magic Hour exposes a bearer-authenticated REST API at api.magichour.ai plus two hosted MCP servers: a creation MCP at mcp.magichour.ai with OAuth or API-key auth, and a public docs-search MCP at docs.magichour.ai/mcp.
